name: [FIX + WIPE] Trade Tower X
desc:
Thank you for 200 likes on the game! Redeem code "200LIKES" on the settings page to get a free item! Next code will be at 300+ likes!
Thank you for 400 favorites on the game! Redeem code "400FAVS" on the settings page to get a free item!

Trade Tower X is a popular Roblox game where players can engage in unboxing cases, trading with fellow players, and more! Players can build their inventories, negotiate deals, and compete to become the wealthiest in the game. Trade Tower X consists of strategic trading decisions and thrilling wager activities. 

ALL CREDITS GOES TO:
* Fund Studios
* Colton (RIP)
* sin
* Xander

Made by Trade Tower X Official

⚠️ Items and currency in this game do NOT transfer to your actual Roblox account!

scripts.title: autofarm script
scripts.features:
🎲 Auto Dice Roll
Automatically rolls dice repeatedly for consistent farming.

🎁 Auto Gift Roll
Automatically joins giveaways every second.

💰 Casebux Farm V1
Rapidly generates Casebux using fast clicking.

💰 Casebux Farm V2
Combines multiple farming methods for faster Casebux gain, including case opening.

🎰 Auto Case Opening
Automatically opens specific cases continuously:

Legendary

Business

Funding

🪙 Auto Quicksell
Automatically sells all items under 500 million value.

🪙 Manual Quicksell Button
One-click button to sell all items under 500 million.

⬆️ Max Casebux Upgrades
Maximizes all Casebux-related upgrades.

⏱️ Case Opening Time Upgrade
Continuously upgrades case opening speed.

⚡ Fastcase: Marcellus
Rapidly opens the 'Marcellus' case.

⚡ Fastcase: Big Boy
Rapidly opens the 'Big Boy' case.

⚡ Fastcase: Eirene
Rapidly opens the 'Eirene' case.

💤 Anti-AFK
Prevents the game from logging you out due to inactivity.

🧹 Game Optimizer
Disables visual effects and reduces game quality to improve performance for multi-instance farming.
